response.title: which home backup batteries can be installed without an electrician

The key distinction is what you want to power during an outage.

Backup type

	

Electrician needed?

No

Battery connected to your home's electrical panel

	

Usually yes

	

Existing wall outlets, lighting circuits, HVAC




Whole-home battery with automatic switchover

	

Yes, typically

	

Most or all household circuits

What do you mean by installing without an electrician?

|---|---|---|
| Portable power station | No | Fridge, router, lights, computers, small appliances |

| Whole-home battery with automatic switchover | Yes, typically | Most or all household circuits |
